##Putting sample through old algorithm
```{python template1NA}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from numpy import isnan
import math as math
import csv

# Constants
excel_file_name = 'sample_template.xlsx'
sub_sheet = 'Sheet1'
keywords_excel = 'final_kw_v1.xlsx'
kw_sub_sheet = 'keywords'


if __name__ == "__main__":

    try:
        df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()

        df['ACCIDENT'] = False
        df['NATURAL'] = False
        df['HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['SUICIDE'] = False
        df['UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['PENDING'] = False

        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'accident', 'ACCIDENT'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'natural', 'NATURAL'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'SUICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'unknown', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'undetermined', 'UNKNOWN'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'pending', 'PENDING'] = True

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:
        kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name='keywords', engine='openpyxl')

        od_keywords = kw_df['OVERDOSE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        heat_keywords = kw_df['HEAT KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        cold_keywords = kw_df['COLD KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        inj_keywords = kw_df['INJURY KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        heart_keywords = kw_df['HEART KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        illness_keywords = kw_df['ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        undetermined_keywords = kw_df['UNDETERMINED'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
        firearm_keywords = kw_df['FIREARM'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.upper()

        df['PRELIM_OD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEAT'] = False
        df['PRELIM_COLD'] = False
        df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['PRELIM_HEART'] = False
        df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['PRELIM_FIREARM'] = False
        df['PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = False

        for kw in od_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OD'] = True

        for kw in heat_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEAT'] = True

        for kw in cold_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_COLD'] = True

        for kw in inj_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'homicide', 'PRELIM_HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[df['MANNER'] == 'suicide', 'PRELIM_SUICIDE'] = True

        for kw in heart_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_HEART'] = True

        for kw in illness_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_ILLNESS'] = True

        for kw in firearm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_FIREARM'] = True

        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'PRELIM_UNKNOWN'] = True

    except:
        print('exception')


    try:

        df['FINAL_ACC_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_ALL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_SUICIDE'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'] = False
        df['MANUAL'] = False

        accident = df['ACCIDENT'].fillna(False)
        natural = df['NATURAL'].fillna(False)
        unknown = df['UNKNOWN'].fillna(False)

        prelim_od = df['PRELIM_OD'].fillna(False)
        prelim_heat = df['PRELIM_HEAT'].fillna(False)
        prelim_cold = df['PRELIM_COLD'].fillna(False)
        prelim_other = df['PRELIM_OTHER_INJURY'].fillna(False)
        prelim_heart = df['PRELIM_HEART'].fillna(False)
        prelim_illness = df['PRELIM_ILLNESS'].fillna(False)
        prelim_homicide = df['PRELIM_HOMICIDE'].fillna(False)
        prelim_suicide = df['PRELIM_SUICIDE'].fillna(False)

        df.loc[accident & prelim_od, 'FINAL_ACC_OD'] = True
        df.loc[~natural & prelim_od, 'FINAL_ALL_OD'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_heat, 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_heat, 'FINAL_HEAT_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_cold, 'FINAL_COLD'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_cold, 'FINAL_COLD_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[accident & prelim_other, 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = True
        df.loc[(accident | unknown) & prelim_other, 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[prelim_homicide, 'FINAL_HOMICIDE'] = True
        df.loc[prelim_suicide, 'FINAL_SUICIDE'] = True

        df.loc[natural & prelim_heart, 'FINAL_HEART'] = True
        df.loc[(natural | unknown) & prelim_heart, 'FINAL_HEART_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[natural & prelim_illness & ~prelim_heart, 'FINAL_ILLNESS'] = True
        df.loc[(natural | unknown) & prelim_illness & ~prelim_heart, 'FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'] = True

        df.loc[unknown, 'FINAL_UNKNOWN'] = True

        df.loc[
            unknown &
            ~prelim_od &
            ~df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK'] &
            ~df['FINAL_HEART_UNK'] &
            ~df['FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK'],
            'FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'
        ] = True


        final_cols = [
            'FINAL_ACC_OD','FINAL_ALL_OD','FINAL_HEAT','FINAL_HEAT_UNK',
            'FINAL_COLD','FINAL_COLD_UNK',
            'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY','FINAL_OTHER_INJURY_UNK',
            'FINAL_HOMICIDE','FINAL_SUICIDE',
            'FINAL_HEART','FINAL_HEART_UNK',
            'FINAL_ILLNESS','FINAL_ILLNESS_UNK',
            'FINAL_UNKNOWN','FINAL_UNKNOWN_UNK'
        ]

        df['MANUAL'] = ~df[final_cols].fillna(False).any(axis=1)

        manual_df = df[df['MANUAL']]
        print(manual_df)

    except Exception as e:
        print('exception', e)
 
    try:
        df['COD'] = 0

        df.loc[df['FINAL_ACC_OD'], 'COD'] = 1
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEAT'], 'COD'] = 2
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COLD'], 'COD'] = 3
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'], 'COD'] = 4
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HOMICIDE'], 'COD'] = 5
        df.loc[df['FINAL_SUICIDE'], 'COD'] = 6
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEART'], 'COD'] = 7
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ILLNESS'], 'COD'] = 8
        df.loc[df['FINAL_UNKNOWN'], 'COD'] = 9
        df.loc[df['MANUAL'], 'COD'] = 0

    except:
        print('exception')


    # SAVE
    df.to_excel('sample_results_og_algorithm.xlsx', index=False)
```

## putting sample through new algorithm 

```{python, newtemplate}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Constants
excel_file_name = 'sample_template.xlsx'
sub_sheet = 'Sheet1'
keywords_excel = 'final_kw_v1.xlsx'
kw_sub_sheet = 'adapted_keywords'

if __name__ == "__main__":


    try:
        df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        # Clean and standardize
        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.strip().str.upper()

        # Extract manner flags using substring matching
        df['ACCIDENT'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('accident', na=False)
        df['HOMICIDE'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('homicide', na=False)
        df['SUICIDE'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('suicide', na=False)
        df['PENDING'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('pending', na=False)
        df['UNKNOWN'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('unknown', na=False) | df['MANNER'].str.contains('undetermined', na=False)
        

        df['NATURAL'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('natural', na=False) | df['MANNER'].str.contains('illness', na=False)

    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 1:', e)
        
    try:
        kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        
        od_keywords = kw_df['OVERDOSE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        cold_keywords = kw_df['COLD KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        heat_keywords = kw_df['HEAT KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        suicide_keywords = kw_df['SUICIDE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        homicide_keywords = kw_df['HOMICIDE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        inj_keywords = kw_df['INJURY KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        heart_keywords = kw_df['HEART KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        comm_keywords = kw_df['COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        non_comm_keywords = kw_df['NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE OR ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()


    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 2:', e)


    try:
  
        df['FINAL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] = False
        df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART'] = False
        df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] = False
        df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE'] = False # Added to track explicit undetermined keywords


        for kw in od_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_OD'] = True

        for kw in cold_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_COLD'] = True

        for kw in heat_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True

        for kw in suicide_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] = True

        for kw in homicide_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'] = True

        for kw in inj_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        for kw in heart_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HEART'] = True

        for kw in comm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] = True

        for kw in non_comm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = True

        for kw in illness_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_ILLNESS'] = True

        # Assume you still have undetermined_keywords from previous block
        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE'] = True


        
        # Non-Communicable is True if it matched its own keywords OR if it's a Heart condition
        df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_HEART']

        # Sub-branches
        df['CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL'] = df['FINAL_COLD'] | df['FINAL_HEAT'] | df['FINAL_OD'] | df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY']
        df['CAUSE_INTENTIONAL'] = df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] | df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE']
        
        # Main Branches
        df['CAUSE_EXTERNAL'] = df['CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL'] | df['CAUSE_INTENTIONAL']
        df['CAUSE_INTERNAL'] = df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_ILLNESS']
        df['CAUSE_UNDETERMINED'] = df['FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE']

        # Manual review tracking
        all_cause_branches = ['CAUSE_EXTERNAL', 'CAUSE_INTERNAL', 'CAUSE_UNDETERMINED']
        df['MANUAL'] = ~df[all_cause_branches].any(axis=1)
     
    except Exception as e:
      print("Exception in Block 3:", e)   

    try:
        df['COD'] = 0

        # 1. Map the broader hierarchical branches first
        df.loc[df['CAUSE_UNDETERMINED'], 'COD'] = 99  # Example fallback for undetermined
        
        # 2. Map specific categories (Order matters: lowest priority to highest priority)
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ILLNESS'], 'COD'] = 10
        df.loc[df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'], 'COD'] = 9 
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'], 'COD'] = 8
        
        # This sits BELOW non-communicable disease, so heart cases get correctly stamped as 7
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEART'], 'COD'] = 7 
        
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'], 'COD'] = 6
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'], 'COD'] = 5
        df.loc[df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'], 'COD'] = 4
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COLD'], 'COD'] = 3
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEAT'], 'COD'] = 2
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OD'], 'COD'] = 1
        
        # If no cause keywords matched at all
        df.loc[df['MANUAL'], 'COD'] = 0

    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 5:', e)

    # Save
    df.to_excel('sample_results_adapted_algorithm.xlsx', index=False)
```

## putting sample through new algorithm with different string distance 

```{python newstrdist}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
import re

# CONFIG

excel_file_name = "sample_template.xlsx"
sub_sheet = "Sheet1"

keywords_excel = "final_kw_v1.xlsx"
kw_sub_sheet = "adapted_keywords"

FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 85


# LOAD DATA

df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine="openpyxl")

df["CAUSE"] = df["CAUSE"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
df["MANNER"] = df["MANNER"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()


# LOAD KEYWORDS

kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet, engine="openpyxl")

def clean(col):
    return kw_df[col].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().str.strip().tolist()

od_keywords = clean("OVERDOSE KEYWORDS")
cold_keywords = clean("COLD KEYWORDS")
heat_keywords = clean("HEAT KEYWORDS")
suicide_keywords = clean("SUICIDE KEYWORDS")
homicide_keywords = clean("HOMICIDE KEYWORDS")
inj_keywords = clean("INJURY KEYWORDS")
heart_keywords = clean("HEART KEYWORDS")
comm_keywords = clean("COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
non_comm_keywords = clean("NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE OR ILLNESS KEYWORDS")

illness_keywords = non_comm_keywords


# CAUSE/MANNER FALLBACK LOGIC

df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] = df["CAUSE"]

missing_cause = df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].eq("")

df.loc[missing_cause, "CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] = df.loc[missing_cause, "MANNER"]

df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"] = df["MANNER"]

missing_manner = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].eq("")

df.loc[missing_manner, "MANNER_FOR_CLASS"] = df.loc[missing_manner, "CAUSE"]


# INITIAL FLAGS

flags = [
    "FINAL_OD",
    "FINAL_COLD",
    "FINAL_HEAT",
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_OTHER_INJURY",
    "FINAL_HEART",
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_ILLNESS",
]

for f in flags:
    df[f] = False


# HELPERS

def fuzzy(text, kws):
    if text == "":
        return False
    
    for kw in kws:
        if fuzz.token_set_ratio(text, kw) >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:
            return True
    
    return False


# CAUSE groups 


cause_groups = {
    "FINAL_OD": od_keywords,
    "FINAL_COLD": cold_keywords,
    "FINAL_HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE": suicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE": homicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_OTHER_INJURY": inj_keywords,
    "FINAL_HEART": heart_keywords,
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_ILLNESS": illness_keywords,
}

# CAUSE matching

df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = ""
df["MATCH_SCORE"] = np.nan
df["MATCH_TYPE"] = ""

for flag, kws in cause_groups.items():

    # exact matches
    for kw in kws:

        mask = (
            df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"]
            .str.contains(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                na=False,
                regex=True
            )
            &
            (df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] == "")
        )

        df.loc[mask, flag] = True
        df.loc[mask, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = kw
        df.loc[mask, "MATCH_SCORE"] = 100
        df.loc[mask, "MATCH_TYPE"] = "Exact"


    # fuzzy fallback
    mask = (df[flag] == False) & (df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] == "")

    for idx, text in df.loc[mask, "CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].items():

        best_kw = None
        best_score = 0

        for kw in kws:
            score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(text, kw)

            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_kw = kw

        if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

            df.loc[idx, flag] = True
            df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = best_kw
            df.loc[idx, "MATCH_SCORE"] = best_score
            df.loc[idx, "MATCH_TYPE"] = "Fuzzy"

# MANNER FLAGS

df["MANNER_HOMICIDE"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "HOMICIDE") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_SUICIDE"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "SUICIDE") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_PENDING"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "PENDING") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
)

df["MANNER_NATURAL"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: (
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "NATURAL") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
        or 
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "ILLNESS") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
    )
)

df["MANNER_UNKNOWN"] = df["MANNER_FOR_CLASS"].apply(
    lambda x: (
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "UNKNOWN") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
        or
        fuzz.token_set_ratio(x, "UNDETERMINED") >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD
    )
)
# CAUSE STRUCTURE

df["CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] = df["FINAL_COLD"] | df["FINAL_HEAT"] | df["FINAL_OD"] | df["FINAL_OTHER_INJURY"]
df["CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"] = df["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"] | df["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]

df["CAUSE_EXTERNAL"] = df["CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] | df["CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"]
df["CAUSE_INTERNAL"] = df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] | df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"] | df["FINAL_ILLNESS"]


# UNDETERMINED 

df["CAUSE_UNDETERMINED"] = ~(
    df["CAUSE_EXTERNAL"] |
    df["CAUSE_INTERNAL"]
)


# MANUAL FLAG

df["MANUAL"] = ~(
    df["CAUSE_EXTERNAL"] |
    df["CAUSE_INTERNAL"] |
    df["CAUSE_UNDETERMINED"]
)

# COD ASSIGNMENT

df["COD"] = 0

df.loc[df["CAUSE_UNDETERMINED"], "COD"] = 99
df.loc[df["FINAL_ILLNESS"], "COD"] = 10
df.loc[df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"], "COD"] = 9
df.loc[df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"], "COD"] = 8
df.loc[df["FINAL_HEART"], "COD"] = 7
df.loc[df["FINAL_OTHER_INJURY"], "COD"] = 6
df.loc[df["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"], "COD"] = 5
df.loc[df["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"], "COD"] = 4
df.loc[df["FINAL_COLD"], "COD"] = 3
df.loc[df["FINAL_HEAT"], "COD"] = 2
df.loc[df["FINAL_OD"], "COD"] = 1

df.loc[df["MANUAL"], "COD"] = 0

# FINAL STRING OUTPUT COLUMNS

def get_final_manner(row):
    if row["MANNER_SUICIDE"]:
        return "SUICIDE"
    if row["MANNER_HOMICIDE"]:
        return "HOMICIDE"
    if row["MANNER_PENDING"]:
        return "PENDING"
    if row["MANNER_NATURAL"]:
        return "NATURAL"
    if row["MANNER_UNKNOWN"]:
        return "UNKNOWN"
    return "UNKNOWN"


def get_final_cause(row):
    if row["FINAL_OD"]:
        return "OVERDOSE"
    if row["FINAL_COLD"]:
        return "COLD"
    if row["FINAL_HEAT"]:
        return "HEAT"
    if row["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "SUICIDE"
    if row["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "HOMICIDE"
    if row["FINAL_OTHER_INJURY"]:
        return "INJURY"
    if row["FINAL_HEART"]:
        return "HEART DISEASE"
    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"
    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"
    if row["FINAL_ILLNESS"]:
        return "ILLNESS"
    if row["CAUSE_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "UNDETERMINED"
    return "UNDETERMINED"


df["FINAL_MANNER_TEXT"] = df.apply(get_final_manner, axis=1)
df["FINAL_CAUSE_TEXT"] = df.apply(get_final_cause, axis=1)


df.to_excel("sample_results_str.xlsx", index=False)

cause = "COMPLICATIONS OF METASTATIC HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA"

for kw in od_keywords:
    score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(cause, kw)
    if score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:
        print(kw, score)
       
df.loc[
    df["CAUSE"].str.contains("HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA", na=False),
    ["CAUSE", "FINAL_OD", "FINAL_COLD", "FINAL_HEAT", "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE", "FINAL_ILLNESS", "COD", "FINAL_CAUSE_TEXT"]
] 


df.columns.tolist()
